protocol.hardware_read: 0xb6 + big-endian 16-bit address; one leading dummy response byte
protocol.fifo: 0x85 READONE, 8-byte records, at most 64 per poll
protocol.ready_wait: 500 ms with 10 ms polling, from ftsTool.h TIMEOUT_RESOLUTION and GENERAL_TIMEOUT
protocol.quiesce: SENSE_OFF then IRQ disable; both must succeed before handoff, and failure remains retryable

excluded: Firmware update, flash erase/program, calibration and manufacturing writes
source_note: Pinned OnePlus Android source; host and source evidence only, no hardware validation.
